author: ReeceyRages99
body:
so im appealing after a year now, i was banned wrongly for hacking. This is what happened, i went into a game and was constantgly being timed out and things like players would freeze and stuff kept happening. Stupidly i ignored this and carried on playing.  When i pvped i only clicked as fast as i could because strafing was impossible with this lag, also when i would eat to saturate hunger it would lag, i would try eat again but by then it had already filled my hunger. I am very sorry for ignoring this and will not let it happen again also im sorry if i annoyed the players and staff.

On my last appeal i was told many accounts were linked to my ip and i honestly have no idea how thats possible, if you could tell me any proof i can give to prove this i would happly be able to, once again sorry

replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Hello Reece,

Since the moderator who banned you is no longer a staff member, your appeal will be forwarded to the seniors. Until they respond, please be patient.

Kind regards,
Pingu/Myworld6.
